---
title: "Methods Map"
toc: true
---

## Descriptive questions

Use descriptive statistics, maps, trend plots, and typologies when the question is: *what is happening, where, and to whom?*

## Mechanism questions

Use theory-building, qualitative evidence, process tracing, or model-based explanation when the question is: *why does this pattern arise?*

## Causal questions

Use experiments, natural experiments, difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, instrumental variables, or matching when the question is: *what is the effect of an intervention or exposure?*

## Prediction questions

Use supervised learning, validation, calibration checks, and error analysis when the question is: *who or where is at higher risk?*
